summary: Independent exact-HEAD performance/concurrency review found no Critical correctness defect. Redis Lua admission is atomic, owner/epoch bound, and fail-closed; focused tests cover exact caps, quota concurrency, duplicate handling, renewal hard limits, cancellation, and fencing, while exact runtime logs cover outage/recovery. The Phase 2 performance gate remains needs-verification because no production-shaped throughput, p95 latency, or resource benchmark was retained and the 12-request outage launch has no strict simultaneous-start barrier. Current enabled plans use concurrency cap 4; full lease-hash scans, per-admission PostgreSQL epoch reads, and broader schema limits are recorded as bounded hardening follow-up.
